name: jomolhari
description: Jomolhari is a free, Unicode compatible, Tibetan script font named after Mt Jomolhari on the border of Bhutan and Tibet. This font can be used for Tibetan and Dzongkha text. It was inspired by Bhutanese manuscript examples and was originally designed for use in publishing traditional Buddhist texts.
